You should report issues with **B2_Command_line_tool** (problems with the tool itself) at [B2 CLI issue tracker](https://github.com/Backblaze/B2_Command_Line_Tool/issues).

You should report issues with **B2 cloud service** (not caused by B2 CLI or sdk) directly to [Backblaze support](https://help.backblaze.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

You should report issues with the B2 python sdk in [b2-sdk-python issue tracker](https://github.com/Backblaze/b2-sdk-python/issues). Authors of tools that interact with the b2 cloud through **b2-sdk-python** should use this tracker. You should also use it if a bug in **b2-sdk-python** clearly causes an issue in another project that uses **b2-sdk-python**.
